BL-803 — promote_and_route_next.sh sed -i is GNU-only: BSD/macOS host dies mid-promote
What it solves: WHAT / WHY: promote_and_route_next.sh:218 runs
`sed -i "s/^assigned_to:.*/assigned_to: ${ROUTE_ROLE}/" "$DEST"`.
GNU sed accepts `-i` with no operand; BSD/macOS sed requires a suffix
operand, so it consumes the expression as the backup suffix and fails.
